title: coap_location_beacon host test cannot build: Kconfig RING_BUFFER tangle (CONFIG_COAP_SERVER/SLIP)
description: Pre-existing build breakage blocking lichen/tests/coap_location_beacon (found while wiring l1qw.32(b)'s 4.01 body): native_sim configure fails in Kconfig with '...depends again on RING_BUFFER (defined at lib/utils/Kconfig:12)' tracing through the LICHEN SLIP transport Kconfig (lichen/subsys/lichen/transport/Kconfig:14 depends on RING_BUFFER; :203 for KISS). The prj.conf combination (CONFIG_COAP_SERVER=y, CONFIG_SLIP=n, CONFIG_TEST_RANDOM_GENERATOR=y also unresolvable on native_sim without an entropy driver) cannot configure on Zephyr 4.1.0. The same tree builds routing_dispatch fine. Fix the Kconfig structure (likely a duplicated/late RING_BUFFER dependency in the LICHEN transport Kconfig or the prj.conf symbol set) so the location host test can run; needed by l1qw.32(b) verification.
